name: QuickClient
tagline: The Fabric client mod that started it all.
summary: A Fabric client mod with 40+ built-in modules, a world map, waypoint beams, a minimap and a customizable HUD. MLBClient is its successor.
description: QuickClient is a client-side Fabric mod for Minecraft with over 40 built-in modules, a world map that remembers what you explored, waypoint beams from bedrock to the sky, a round minimap and a HUD you can arrange however you like. Its modules live on in MLBClient, and the MLBClient Launcher can install QuickClient as a second client.

seo.title: QuickClient – Fabric client mod
seo.description: QuickClient: a Fabric client mod for Minecraft with 40+ modules, world map, waypoint beams and minimap. Download on CurseForge.

items.title: 40+ modules
items.text: Performance, HUD, navigation, visual and utility modules. Every module is off until you turn it on.

items.title: World map & minimap
items.text: Explored terrain saved per world and dimension, plus a round, rotating minimap.

items.title: Waypoints
items.text: Coloured beams from bedrock to the sky, a compass strip and a breadcrumb trail.

items.title: Your HUD
items.text: Arrange every widget with the HUD editor.
